DRAFT RULES 1. (1) These rules may be called the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) (Amendment) Rules, 2019. 2. For sub-rule (1) of Rule 56 of the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Rules, 2002 (hereinafter referred as the principal rules), the following sub rule shall be substituted: “(1) An application to the Registrar for the registration under Section 17 by a producer as an authorized user of the registered geographical indication shall be made by the proposed authorized user in Form GI-3 and shall be accompanied by a Statement of Case of how he claims to be the producer of the registered geographical indication. The applicant shall also forward a copy of the application to the registered proprietor, and intimate the Registrar of due service of the same. ” 3. Sub-rule (2) of rule 56 of the principal rules shall be deleted. 4. In sub-rule (1) of Rule 59 of the principal rules, the following sub-rule shall be substituted : (1) Where no notice of opposition is filed to an application advertised or re-advertised in the Journal within the period specified under sub-clause (e) of sub-section (3) of Section 17 or where an opposition is filed and it is dismissed, the Registrar shall enter the authorised user in Part B of the register and shall issue a registration certificate with the seal of Geographical Indication Registry. 5. Clauses (f) and (g) of sub rule (2) of rule 59 of the principal rules shall be deleted. 6. In sub-rule (3) of Rule 59 of the principal rules, the following shall be deleted : “An unmounted representation of the geographical indication exactly as shown in the form of application for registration thereof at the time of registration shall accompany such request.” 7.
